 return np.stack(((zz*pp)@hweights,(pp+zz*p1)@hweights,(p1*(2+zz*(1-2*pp)))@hweights))

 gp=g@rx; up=u@rx
 cv=(1-cy)*np.einsum('ij,ij->i',g,u)+cy*D*gp*up
 va=(1-cy)*np.einsum('ij,ij->i',g,g)+cy*D*gp*gp
 fs=silu_moments(ay*np.sqrt(D)*gp,va)

 return gu*fs[0]+cv*fs[1],fs[0],gu*fs[1]+cv*fs[2]

def silu_moments4(mu,var):

 return np.stack(((zz*pp)@hweights,(pp+zz*p1)@hweights,(p1*(2+zz*pm))@hweights,(p1*(pm*(3+zz*pm)-2*zz*p1))@hweights))

def gauss_row(g,u,mu,Bmom,Cmom,sig):
 gp=g@Bmom; up=u@Bmom
 va=sig*np.einsum('ij,ij->i',g,g)+np.sum((gp@Cmom)*gp,1)
 cv=sig*np.einsum('ij,ij->i',g,u)+np.sum((gp@Cmom)*up,1)
 mg,um=g@mu,u@mu
 fs=silu_moments4(mg,va)
 eg,ec=fs[0],um*fs[1]+cv*fs[2]
 return um*eg+cv*fs[1],eg,ec,fs,cv,um,va

def learned_basis(ll,k=20):
 xs=[]
 for j0 in range(max(ll-1,8),min(ll+2,20)):
  for nm in [un,gn,vn]:
   ga=GN[j0] if nm in mlps else AN[j0]; da=DSV[j0,nm]
   vv=(da[2][:7] / np.maximum(0.2,abs(ga))) * np.sqrt(da[1][:7,None]/da[1][0]);
   xs.append(unit(vv,1)*np.sqrt(da[1][:7,None]/da[1][0]))
 extra=np.eye(D,dtype=np.float32)[np.array([490,624,463,190,570,541,547,559])]
 mm=np.concatenate([cmread[ll][0][None,:]*4, cmread[ll][1][None,:], *xs, extra*.65],axis=0)
 uu,ss,vv=la.svd(mm,full_matrices=False)
 return vv[:k].T.copy()

def fitmom(ll, shrink=1., k=21, target_strength=2.6):
 px0,pv0=cmread[ll]; d0,g0,u0=[wt(ll,n) for n in mlps]; d1,g1,u1=[delta(pre(ll)+n) for n in mlps]; nm=GN[ll]
 bm=learned_basis(ll,k); rx=unit(bm.T@px0); cm0=.06*D*np.outer(rx,rx); mu0=-.22*np.sqrt(D)*px0; sig=.94
 gi,ui=g0*nm,u0*nm

 # Keep changes modest when the code is underdetermined. Scale corrections in
 # normalized residual units, with less trust in covariance off the inferred basis.
 RX=np.concatenate([.6*dx,2.3*cw],axis=1)
 rsc=(.38+np.sqrt(var))**-.65; rsc=np.minimum(rsc,1.4)
 GG=(RX*rsc[:,None]).T@(RX*rsc[:,None]); gscale=np.percentile(np.diag(GG),80)
 yt=-act_sig_grad(ll,dn,pcwrite([ll])); yn=target_strength*yt
 # Deal with the optimizer's likely compression of large intermediate coordinates.
 zz=np.clip(m0,-.3,.3); rr=rsc*(yn-zz)
 cf=sla.solve(GG+(.32*shrink*gscale)*np.eye(RX.shape[1]), (RX*rsc[:,None]).T@rr, assume_a='pos',check_finite=False)
 cnew=cm0.copy(); cnew[ix,jx]+=2.3*cf[k:]; cnew[jx,ix]=cnew[ix,jx]
 ei,ev=la.eigh(cnew); cnew=(ev*np.maximum(ei,-.5))@ev.T
 muj=mu0+bm@(.6*cf[:k]);
 m0n,f0n,c0n,*_=gauss_row(gi,ui,muj,bm,cnew,sig)
 m1n,f1n,c1n,*_=gauss_row((g0+g1)*nm,(u0+u1)*nm,muj,bm,cnew,sig)
 dwr=(d0+d1)@m1n-d0@m0n
 J1=((d0+d1)@((u0+u1)*f1n[:,None]+(g0+g1)*c1n[:,None]))*nm/(refnorm[ll]/np.sqrt(D))
 return dwr.astype(np.float32), J1.astype(np.float32), (muj,bm,cnew, sig), np.array([unit(m0)@yt,unit(m0n)@yt, la.norm(muj), np.trace(cnew), unit(dwr)@basecond])

learnMom={ll:fitmom(ll) for ll in range(8,19)}
print('layer diagnostics: Down read agreement before/after, mu length, covariance inferred trace, write vs good direction');
for ll,mom0 in learnMom.items(): print(ll,np.round(mom0[-1],3))"}

{"code":"note('Practice #15: closed-form preactivation preimage blended with counterwrite scored .3702 medical / .3210 general. It is weaker than the direct conditional counterwrite. No evidence that compensating preactivations themselves is better than compensating residual writes at L=13.');
# Conditional cross moments of the MLP branch gradient with its learned
# input feature. Decode shared residual gradient from many independent rows.
def moment_cross(ll,use_learn=.25):
 d0,g0,u0=[wt(ll,n) for n in mlps]; nm=GN[ll]; gp,up=g0*nm,u0*nm
 ax=cmread[ll][0]; mu=-.22*np.sqrt(D)*ax; Cax=(.94+.06*D)*ax
 BM=ax[:,None]; CM=np.array([[.06*D]],np.float32)
 mm,f0,c0,fs,cv,um,va=gauss_row(gp,up,mu,BM,CM,.94)
 KU=f0*(mu@ax)+fs[1]*(gp@Cax)
 KG=c0*(mu@ax)+(up@Cax)*fs[1]+(gp@Cax)*(um*fs[2]+cv*fs[3])
 x0=ax*np.sign(nm)/np.maximum(abs(nm),.28)
 # Extract the trained update, subtracting exact initializer and compressing
 # dominant rows minimally: k-vector pairs with the same read observation.
 udp={}
 for nm0,km in [(un,KU),(gn,KG)]:
  aa,bb,sc=F[ll,nm0]; td= -(bb@(dA[ll,nm0]@x0))*sc
  # Rescale according to magnitudes in the view, exclude very weakly determined rows.
  en=np.sqrt(np.mean(td**2)); kn=np.sqrt(np.mean(km**2)); km=km/kn
  dk=.65+.35*np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(d0,axis=0),.03)/.3)
  Q1=d0.T*(np.sign(km)*np.minimum(abs(km),1.5)/dk)[:,None]
  Y1=np.clip(td/en, -2.8,2.8)/dk
  udp[nm0]=(Q1,Y1)
 return udp

def estimate_branch_score(ll,alpha=.35):
 local=pcwrite([ll]); d0=wt(ll,dn)
 dec=moment_cross(ll); terms=[]; meta=[]
 for nm,y0 in dec.items():
  X0,Y0=y0
  vv=X0.T@Y0; gg=X0.T@X0; sc=np.trace(gg)/D; match=unit(Y0)@unit(X0@local);
  if match<0: vv=-vv
  w0=unit(sla.solve(gg+alpha*sc*I,vv,assume_a='pos'));
  terms.append(w0); meta.append([match,unit(vv)@local,w0@local,w0@basecond])
 return terms,meta
allbs={ll:estimate_branch_score(ll) for ll in range(9,18)}
for ll in allbs: print(ll,np.round(np.array(allbs[ll][1]),3).ravel())"}

{"code":"# Static rotary score/value covariance and first-moment differences from weight
# contractions alone. There are no token inputs or attention matrices.
rot_offsets=np.array([0.,1.,2.,4.,8.,16.,32.,64.],np.float32)
rot_fact=(1e6)**(-np.arange(32,dtype=np.float32)/32.0)
rot_w=np.array([.08,.14,.16,.17,.16,.13,.10,.06],np.float32)
def tilt_statistics(ll,using_delta=False, a_v=-.22, cov_v=.06, a_q=-.16, cap=1.5, qk_delta=None):
    ba_q,ba_k,ba_v=[load(pre(ll)+name+'.bias') for name in [qn,kn,vn]]
    mats=[wt(ll,name).copy() for name in [qn,kn,vn,on]]
    if qk_delta is None: qk_delta=using_delta
    if qk_delta:
        for j0,name in enumerate([qn,kn]): mats[j0]+=delta(pre(ll)+name)
    if using_delta:
        for j0,name in enumerate([vn,on],2): mats[j0]+=delta(pre(ll)+name)
    qw,kw,vw,ow=mats
    ga = AN[ll]
    rx,rv = cmread[ll]
    k_dir=ga*rv
    q_meanb=(ba_q+(a_q*np.sqrt(D))*(qw@(ga*rx))).reshape(14,64)
    k_head=(kw*ga[None,:]).reshape(2,64,D).repeat(7,axis=0)
    v_head=(vw*ga[None,:]).reshape(2,64,D).repeat(7,axis=0)
    # Before considering scoring, the context second moment is an isotropic prior
    # plus an anisotropy supported by the signed learned value-read direction.
    k_r=k_head@rv
    v_r=v_head@rv
    vu0=ba_v.reshape(2,64).repeat(7,axis=0)+(a_v*np.sqrt(D))*v_r
    cross_kv=(1.-cov_v)*np.matmul(v_head,k_head.transpose(0,2,1))+(cov_v*D)*v_r[:,:,None]*k_r[:,None,:]
    cov_kk=(1.-cov_v)*np.matmul(k_head,k_head.transpose(0,2,1))+(cov_v*D)*k_r[:,:,None]*k_r[:,None,:]
    qt=rotnom(q_meanb[None,:,:],rot_offsets[:,None,None]*rot_fact[None,None,:])/8.
    mass=(np.einsum('lhj,hjk,lhk->lh',qt,cov_kk,qt)).clip(0)
    gain=1/np.sqrt(1+mass/(cap*cap))
    vv0=(np.einsum('hij,lhj,lh,l->hi',cross_kv,qt,gain,rot_w)).reshape(D)
    return (ow@vu0.ravel(),ow@vv0,vu0.ravel(),vv0,np.sqrt(mass).mean())
TV0={ll:tilt_statistics(ll,False) for ll in range(9,17)}
TV1={ll:tilt_statistics(ll,True) for ll in range(9,17)}
TV2={ll:tilt_statistics(ll,True,qk_delta=False) for ll in range(9,17)}
for ll in range(9,17):

    qq=pcwrite([ll]);xs0=unit(-act_sig_grad(ll,on,qq))
    d0,d1,d2=r1[0]-r0[0],r1[1]-r0[1],r1[1]-r2[1]
    print(ll,'O signature',[round(float(unit(x)@xs0),3) for x in [r0[2],r0[3],r0[2]+r0[3]]], 'delta writes',np.round([[la.norm(x),x@qq,x@best] for x in [d0,d1,d2]],4).tolist(),'score SD',round(float(r0[4]),2))"}

# contractions alone. There are no token inputs or attention matrices.
rot_offsets=np.array([0.,1.,2.,4.,8.,16.,32.,64.],np.float32)
rot_fact=(1e6)**(-np.arange(32,dtype=np.float32)/32.0)
rot_w=np.array([.08,.14,.16,.17,.16,.13,.10,.06],np.float32)
def tilt_statistics(ll,using_delta=False, a_v=-.22, cov_v=.06, a_q=-.16, cap=1.5, qk_delta=None):
    ba_q,ba_k,ba_v=[load(pre(ll)+name+'.bias') for name in [qn,kn,vn]]
    mats=[wt(ll,name).copy() for name in [qn,kn,vn,on]]
    if qk_delta is None: qk_delta=using_delta
    if qk_delta:
        for j0,name in enumerate([qn,kn]): mats[j0]+=delta(pre(ll)+name)
    if using_delta:
        for j0,name in enumerate([vn,on],2): mats[j0]+=delta(pre(ll)+name)
    qw,kw,vw,ow=mats
    ga = AN[ll]
    rx,rv = cmread[ll]
    k_dir=ga*rv
    q_meanb=(ba_q+(a_q*np.sqrt(D))*(qw@(ga*rx))).reshape(14,64)
    k_head=(kw*ga[None,:]).reshape(2,64,D).repeat(7,axis=0)
    v_head=(vw*ga[None,:]).reshape(2,64,D).repeat(7,axis=0)
    # Before considering scoring, the context second moment is an isotropic prior
    # plus an anisotropy supported by the signed learned value-read direction.
    k_r=k_head@rv
    v_r=v_head@rv
    vu0=ba_v.reshape(2,64).repeat(7,axis=0)+(a_v*np.sqrt(D))*v_r
    cross_kv=(1.-cov_v)*np.matmul(v_head,k_head.transpose(0,2,1))+(cov_v*D)*v_r[:,:,None]*k_r[:,None,:]
    cov_kk=(1.-cov_v)*np.matmul(k_head,k_head.transpose(0,2,1))+(cov_v*D)*k_r[:,:,None]*k_r[:,None,:]
    qt=rotnom(q_meanb[None,:,:],rot_offsets[:,None,None]*rot_fact[None,None,:])/8.
    mass=(np.einsum('lhj,hjk,lhk->lh',qt,cov_kk,qt)).clip(0)
    gain=1/np.sqrt(1+mass/(cap*cap))
    vv0=(np.einsum('hij,lhj,lh,l->hi',cross_kv,qt,gain,rot_w)).reshape(D)
    return (ow@vu0.ravel(),ow@vv0,vu0.ravel(),vv0,np.sqrt(mass).mean())

# measured loss and all targets are weight-derived adapter write moments.
cf_neg=(-.22,.06)

def signed_local_drift(ll,learn_fraction=.40,score_fraction=.42):
    qm=-pcwrite([ll]); sgn_in=act_sig_grad(ll,on,qm)
    cmo=6.*flapply(ll,on,sgn_in)
    # O-input movement selects an O-only drift with empirical sign from the
    # actual trained factor, rather than choosing a random O input direction.
    ml=(1.-learn_fraction)*cond[ll,cf_neg][0]+learn_fraction*learnMom[ll][0]
    # The K/Q-specific weight-only score covariance is small and lacks a
    # consistent support along the estimated shared residual write. Do not use it.
    att=score_fraction*cmo
    return (ml+att).astype(np.float32)

L13loc=13
op13={ll:cond_path(ll,ll+1,cf_neg) for ll in range(8,18)}
local_drift13={ll:signed_local_drift(ll) for ll in range(8,18)}
print([(ll,round(float(local_drift13[ll]@best),3),round(float((cond[ll,cf_neg][0]-local_drift13[ll])@best),3)) for ll in range(8,18)])

def joint_residual_agreement(L, left=5, right=5, damp=.33, write_shrink=.42, forecast=1.):
    b0=np.zeros(D,np.float32)
    for ll in range(L-left,L):
        b0=op13[ll]@b0-np.exp(-.5*((ll-(L-.5))/2.65)**2)*local_drift13[ll]
    P0=I.copy()
    # Standard constrained linear combination of propagated correction matrices.
    A0=np.zeros_like(I); y0=np.zeros(D,np.float32); wsum=0.
    for dep in range(right+1):
        w0=np.exp(-.5*((dep-1.65)/1.60)**2)
        A0+=w0*(P0.T@P0); y0+=w0*(P0.T@b0); wsum+=w0
        if dep<right:
            b0=op13[L+dep]@b0-forecast*np.exp(-.5*((dep+.5)/3.1)**2)*local_drift13[L+dep]
            P0=op13[L+dep]@P0
    sh=PU@(((PS/PS[0])**1.2)*(PU.T@y0))
    y0=(1-write_shrink)*unit(y0)+write_shrink*unit(sh)
    # Stable floor against broad native-logit movement.
    JH=Hxt/(np.trace(Hxt)/D)
    v0=unit(sla.solve(A0/wsum+damp*JH+.18*I,y0,assume_a='pos',check_finite=False))
    return v0

jagree=joint_residual_agreement(13)
for st in [0,.25,.45,.7,1.]:
    alt=unit((1-st)*best+st*jagree)
    print(st,'cos to base',round(float(alt@best),5),'axis',round(float(alt@pcwrite([12,13])),4),'output cov',round(float(alt@Hxt@alt),4))
print('best output cov',float(best@Hxt@best))"}

{"code":"# Closed-form second directional moments of weight rows, integrated over a
# joint Gaussian prior. This contracts a weight-only curvature tensor with a
# proposed residual translate. No MLP is evaluated on inputs or tokens.
def swi_norm_curvature(ll, vv, axmu=-.22, cov_r=.06, ad=True):
    d,g,u = [wt(ll,nm) for nm in [dn,gn,un]]
    if ad:
        d,g,u=[a0+delta(pre(ll)+nm) for a0,nm in zip([d,g,u],[dn,gn,un])]
    g = g*GN[ll][None,:]
    u = u*GN[ll][None,:]
    r = cmread[ll][0]
    mu = axmu*np.sqrt(D)*r
    q = vv*(np.sqrt(D)/refnorm[ll])
    qa = q/D
    qb = float(q@q)/D
    qa_mean = float(qa@mu)
    qa_sigr = (1-cov_r)*qa+cov_r*D*(r@qa)*r
    qa_var = float(qa@qa_sigr)
    gp = g@q; up=u@q
    mg=g@mu; mu_u=u@mu
    gr=g@r; ur=u@r
    GG=(1-cov_r)*np.einsum('ij,ij->i',g,g)+cov_r*D*gr**2
    GU=(1-cov_r)*np.einsum('ij,ij->i',g,u)+cov_r*D*gr*ur
    GA=g@qa_sigr
    UA=u@qa_sigr
    X = (np.sqrt(np.maximum(GG,1e-9))[:,None]*nodes[None,:])
    mg_grid = mg[:,None] + X
    U0 = mu_u[:,None] + (GU/GG)[:,None]*X
    A0 = qa_mean + (GA/GG)[:,None]*X
    A2 = A0*A0 + np.maximum(0, qa_var-GA*GA/GG)[:,None]
    covUA = (UA - GU*GA/GG)[:,None]
    UA1 = U0*A0 + covUA
    UA2 = U0*A2 + 2*A0*covUA
    G0 = mg_grid
    p=expit(G0); p1=p*(1-p)
    s0=G0*p; s1=p+G0*p1; s2=p1*(2+G0*(1-2*p))
    gv = gp[:,None]; uv=up[:,None]
    # E[f''(G)G'^2 U + f'(G)G''U + 2 f'(G)G'U' + f(G)U''].
    term = s2*(gv*gv*U0-2*gv*G0*UA1+G0*G0*UA2) + s1*((5*UA2-qb*U0)*G0-4*gv*UA1+2*gv*uv-2*G0*uv*A0) + s0*(3*UA2-qb*U0-2*uv*A0)
    branch = d@(term@hweights)
    return .5*branch

# nodes and hweights are the kernel's existing normalized Hermite rule.
print(nodes[:4],hweights[:4],np.sum(hweights),np.sum(hweights*nodes**2))
for ll in range(13,16):
    op0=cond_path(13,ll,cf_neg)
    st0=op0@(3.55*best)
    a,b=swi_norm_curvature(ll,st0),swi_norm_curvature(ll,st0,0.)
    print(ll,la.norm(st0),np.round([la.norm(a),la.norm(b),a@best,b@best,unit(a)@unit(b)],4))"}
